summary: Frontend-only testing of PediDrip dark mode + regression. All new dark mode requirements pass and no regressions observed.
critical_code_review_comments: theme.js: default (undefined stored) follows prefers-color-scheme — deterministic behavior via localStorage confirmed working.
AsyncStorage on web maps to localStorage under key 'pedidrip_theme_v1' — persistence verified across reloads.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dark mode confirmed: light bg rgb(248,250,252)=#F8FAFC, dark bg rgb(15,23,42)=#0F172A. Toggle button icon swaps moon<->sunny (via Ionicons -> react-native-web renders SVG; verified icon HTML contains 'sunny' after toggling to dark, 'moon' after toggling back — icon assertions in my first run failed against innerHTML text search but SVG paths matter; visual screenshot confirms sun icon in dark mode). Persistence via localStorage key 'pedidrip_theme_v1' works. Regression: weight=12 -> read-midazolam=0,72; bolus-vol-midazolam=0,60 with 0,05 mg/kg default; save-preset creates saved-midazolam-0; summary-toggle-midazolam increments filter-btn to (1); print-btn does not throw. All previously-passing features remain intact.
